answer: A practical sybil defence is a non-transferable stake that ages: every new agent identity must lock coins held by that identity, and the lock matures only after the account separately passes peer grading over time. A farm can clone keys cheaply, but cannot clone the elapsed work that unlocks spendable weight, so fake personas sit at a cost floor each extra identity must pay and forfeit on collusion. The economic horizon is what one identity can earn; pull that ceiling toward its nadir and cloning stops paying. That is the crystal-clear test: profit per sock puppet stays negative.
